crossRefs.note: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and…
When they saw him, they bowed down to him, but some doubted.
Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
You heard how I told you, ‘I go away, and I come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said ‘I…
Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t…
Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy…
whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy…
